dedupe_keys.name: ecuador electricity consumption in quito and santa cruz 2019 2020 arc consumption reports as shapefiles hdx

description: These two Humanitarian Data Exchange datasets, published by Hub Latin America with the Instituto de Geografia of the Universidad San Francisco de Quito and the U.S. Department of State as source, give electricity consumption in Quito and in Santa Cruz, Ecuador, for 2019 and 2020. The page says the statistics come from the Agency for the Regulation and Control of Energy and Non-Renewable Natural Resources (ARC) through electrical consumption reports, collected for statistical operations of the Ecuadorian electricity sector and shown through the SISDATA programme. Each city is one zipped shapefile. They are free to download under CC BY-SA and were last modified in August 2021, with a yearly update frequency listed. Coverage is the two cities. Caveats: the pages do not describe the spatial units, fields or customer classes, and no update since 2021 is visible. Simulation uses are spatial electricity demand for city-level planning and exposure studies in Ecuador. Related records: data-salinas-ecuador-oil-wells-vulnerability is another Ecuador energy dataset.
